specs.Specific Uses For Product: Entertainment, Mobile Photography, Heavy Usage, Outdoor Activities, Photography

features: [ZEISS-Powered Photography]: Capture detailed images across a variety of scenes with a 50 MP ZEISS OIS Main Camera, a 50 MP ZEISS Night Telephoto Camera with OIS, and an 8 MP ZEISS Ultra Wide-Angle Camera with a 115° field of view.
[Picture-Perfect Group Selfies]: Bring everyone into the frame with the 50 MP ZEISS Group Selfie Camera, featuring autofocus and a wide 92° field of view for clear and detailed selfies.

[Performance-Driven Experience]: Handle everyday tasks, multitasking, entertainment, and gaming with the Qualcomm Snapdragon 7 Gen 4 Mobile Platform, featuring an octa-core CPU and an efficient 4 nm process.
[Power That Keeps Going]: Stay powered for longer with a massive 7200 mAh typical-capacity battery, designed to support everyday communication, entertainment, photography, and more.

[Rapid 90W Charging]: Spend less time plugged in with 90W Fast Charging when using the official vivo standard charger. Actual charging power and speed may vary depending on usage and environmental conditions.

[Ultra-Smooth Visual Experience]: Enjoy fluid and responsive visuals on the 6.59-inch AMOLED display, featuring 2750 × 1260 resolution, up to a 144 Hz refresh rate, 459 PPI, and support for the P3 wide colour gamut.
[Brilliant Viewing, Even in Bright Light]: Experience clear and vivid visuals with 1800 nits HBM brightness and up to 5000 nits local peak brightness.
[Room for More]: Store apps, photos, videos, and files with 8 GB RAM and a choice of 128 GB, 256 GB, or 512 GB storage, supported by LPDDR4X RAM, UFS 3.1 storage, and up to 16 GB Extended RAM.

[Ready for Everyday Adventures]: Take on challenging environments with IP68 and IP69 protection against dust, continuous water immersion, and high-pressure, high-temperature water jets under controlled laboratory conditions. Water and dust resistance may reduce over time, and liquid damage is not covered under warranty.

[Advanced Connectivity in a Sleek Design]: Stay connected with 5G, Dual SIM Dual Active support for compatible band combinations, eSIM, Wi-Fi, Bluetooth 5.4, NFC, OTG, GPS, and an infrared blaster, all packed into a glass-back design measuring approximately 7.69 mm in thickness and weighing 203 g.
